subject.title: fix(workspace): prevent false Missing labels on existing files and fix panel layout overlap

question: Should `sessions.files.list` ever expose existence, size, or mtime for transcript-mentioned paths outside the fs-safe workspace boundary, or should this PR preserve containment and solve the UI with filtering or a neutral external-file state?
rationale: The patch can be mechanically changed, but the permanent product/security contract for external transcript paths affects a shared Gateway read method and cannot be safely inferred from the PR alone.

options.title: Preserve fs-safe containment
options.body: Remove the raw stat fallback and fix the rail with filtering or a neutral external state while keeping filesystem metadata behind the workspace helper.

options.title: Accept external metadata deliberately
options.body: Allow list-only external metadata, but require explicit security acceptance, protocol/UI tests, and clear semantics for symlinks and directories.

options.title: Split the layout work away
options.body: Close or replace this stale branch after keeping the already-merged layout fix and handling file semantics in the canonical issue.

recommendation.title: Preserve fs-safe containment
recommendation.body: Remove the raw stat fallback and fix the rail with filtering or a neutral external state while keeping filesystem metadata behind the workspace helper.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the original rail feature and the narrower current-main layout fix, making them the best available routing owner for this boundary choice.
